_meta.notes: Country-scoped curated nodes; link via relationships during ingest.

nodes.name: Median Unification
nodes.label: Median Unification
nodes.description: Political movement unifying Iranian tribes under Median leadership, establishing the first Iranian empire.

nodes.name: Early Zoroastrianism
nodes.label: Early Zoroastrianism
nodes.description: Religious reform movement founded by Zoroaster promoting monotheistic worship of Ahura Mazda and ethical dualism.

nodes.name: Achaemenid Expansion
nodes.label: Achaemenid Expansion
nodes.description: Persian imperial expansion under Cyrus, Darius, and Xerxes creating the largest ancient empire from Egypt to India.

nodes.name: Mazdakism
nodes.label: Mazdakism
nodes.description: Late Sasanian religious and social movement advocating communal property and egalitarianism under Mazdak.

nodes.name: Manichaeism
nodes.label: Manichaeism
nodes.description: Syncretic religious movement founded by Mani in 3rd century Persia, spreading from Rome to China.

nodes.name: Shu'ubiyya Movement
nodes.label: Shu'ubiyya Movement
nodes.description: Literary and cultural movement asserting Persian cultural equality or superiority to Arabs within Islamic civilization.

nodes.name: Persian Sufi Orders
nodes.label: Persian Sufi Orders
nodes.description: Mystical brotherhoods including Kubrawiyya and Naqshbandiyya spreading Sufi practice throughout Iran and beyond.

nodes.name: Ismaili Movement in Persia
nodes.label: Ismaili Movement in Persia
nodes.description: Shia Ismaili political and religious movement establishing the Alamut state under Hassan-i Sabbah.

nodes.name: Safavid Revolution
nodes.label: Safavid Revolution
nodes.description: Movement establishing the Safavid dynasty and imposing Twelver Shiism as Iran's state religion.

nodes.name: Qizilbash Movement
nodes.label: Qizilbash Movement
nodes.description: Turkic tribal confederacy devoted to the Safavid order, providing military power for the dynasty's rise.

nodes.name: Persian Artistic Renaissance
nodes.label: Persian Artistic Renaissance
nodes.description: Cultural flowering under Safavid patronage in architecture, miniature painting, carpet weaving, and calligraphy.

nodes.name: Babi Movement
nodes.label: Babi Movement
nodes.description: 19th century religious movement founded by the Bab, leading to the emergence of the Baha'i Faith.

nodes.name: Persian Constitutional Revolution
nodes.label: Persian Constitutional Revolution
nodes.description: 1905-1911 movement establishing constitutional monarchy and parliament, limiting Qajar absolutism.

nodes.name: Reza Shah Modernization
nodes.label: Reza Shah Modernization
nodes.description: State-driven modernization under Reza Shah including secularization, industrialization, and national education.

nodes.name: Iranian Islamic Revolution
nodes.label: Iranian Islamic Revolution
nodes.description: 1979 popular revolution overthrowing the Pahlavi monarchy and establishing the Islamic Republic under Khomeini.

nodes.name: Iranian Green Movement
nodes.label: Iranian Green Movement
nodes.description: 2009 protest movement challenging disputed presidential election results and demanding political reform.

nodes.name: Woman Life Freedom Movement
nodes.label: Woman Life Freedom Movement
nodes.description: 2022 protests sparked by Mahsa Amini's death, demanding women's rights and political change in Iran.
